question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.**

The first people to live in an area
solution:
The correct answer is **'Native'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• **Provincial** - an inhabitant of a province of a country or empire. (प्रांतीय)
 
• **Native** - relating to the first people to live in an area. (मूल निवासी)
 
• **Colonial** - a native or inhabitant of a colony. (औपनिवेशिक)
 
• **Local** - an inhabitant of a particular area or neighborhood. (स्थानीय)
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that **native** is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.
